# CraftMyFunnel

> Governed AI-driven B2B outreach and qualified meeting workflow platform.

CraftMyFunnel helps B2B service teams, agencies, and revenue operations manage buyer signals, AI-personalized outreach with mandatory human-in-the-loop approvals, email deliverability guardrails, and qualified meeting tracking.

## Core Capabilities

- **Governed Multi-Channel Outreach**: Orchestrates personalized outreach via Gmail/Google Workspace with Phase-2 support for LinkedIn and WhatsApp.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Approval Queue**: Every AI-generated draft requires explicit human review and approval before dispatching, preventing unvetted AI hallucinations or brand damage.
- **Deliverability & Reputation Guardrails**: Automated mailbox warm-up tracking, bounce-rate circuit breakers, RFC 5322 Message-ID threading, and RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe compliance.
- **Buyer Signal & Intent Ingestion**: Scrapes and ingests signals from LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CSV lists, webhooks, and inbound landing agents.
- **Transactional Outbox & Blind Indexing**: Enterprise-grade multi-tenant architecture with atomic outbox relay loops and deterministic HMAC-SHA256 blind indexing for encrypted PII search.
- **Vertical Playbooks**: Pre-configured outbound sequence templates and prompts tailored for SaaS, IT services, consulting, marketing agencies, and recruiting.

## Target Audience

- B2B Lead Generation & Marketing Agencies
- High-Growth SaaS Outbound Sales Teams
- Professional Services & Consulting Firms
- Revenue Operations & Demand Generation Leaders

## Platform Comparisons & Alternatives

- [CraftMyFunnel vs Apollo.io](https://craftmyfunnel.live/vs/apollo): Governed outbound workflows with approval gates vs contact database sequencer.
- [CraftMyFunnel vs Instantly](https://craftmyfunnel.live/vs/instantly): Quality and reputation protection vs mass cold email blasting.
- [CraftMyFunnel vs Lemlist](https://craftmyfunnel.live/vs/lemlist): Vertical industry playbooks and multi-tenant security vs generic sequences.
